notes: Automatic volume no longer turns up a fan the voice detector mistook for speech, and the voice gate closes on a steady background. 10 ms less delay from microphone to packet at 48 kHz. Loss recovery is now Automatic by default: on when packets go missing, off after a clean minute, with no gap when it switches. Noise suppression is measured on a repeatable bench; RNNoise stays the default. Includes a new client, schema-30 server and iroh helper; no server code changed.
